sloka: इति उक्त्वा क्रोध ताम्र अक्षः स्फुरमाण ओष्ट संपुटः ।वल्कल अजिनम् आबद्ध्य जटा भारम् बन्धयत् ॥३-६४-७२॥
transliteration: iti uktvā krodha tāmra akṣaḥ sphuramāṇa oṣṭa saṁpuṭaḥ ।valkala ajinam ābaddhya jaṭā bhāram bandhayat ॥3-64-72॥

translations.english: After speaking these words, handsome Rama, his eyes red with anger, pressed his bow, took out the glowing arrow that was dreadful like a poisonous serpent, fixed it to his bow and said these words in a rage like the fire at the time of dissolution of the world.
